title: Technology Sector Update for 08/02/2018: ESIO,FTNT,ARRS - Nasdaq.com
text:

MSFT -0.75%

CSCO -0.41%
GOOG -0.64%
Technology stocks were softer in today's pre-market.
Among technology stocks moving on news:
+ Electro Scientific Industries ( ESIO ) raced over 21% in early trading after the electronic components company reporting fiscal financial results beating analyst projections and issued Q2 earnings guidance also exceeding Street views.
In other sector news:
+ Fortinet ( FTNT ) climbed over 8% in early trade after reporting Q2 financial results exceeding the Capital IQ consensus, prompting analysts at BMO Capital Markets raising their price target for the company stock by $15 to $76 a share.
- HubSpot ( HUBS ) slid almost 4% lower Thursday morning after posting Q2 EPS, revenue trailing analyst estimates for the three months ended June 30.
